name: Rikubetsu (Japan)
description: A green field charged at the centre with the Rikubetsu town emblem in white: two concentric broken rings.
history: Municipal flag of Rikubetsu, a town in Hokkaido; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. Flag and emblem were adopted in March 1950.

features.role: Rikubetsu town emblem — two concentric broken rings
